name: @dooz/native
description: Tauri shell that ships the dooz web client as a desktop and mobile app

scripts.android:init: tauri android init && npm run icons
scripts.ios:init: tauri ios init && npm run icons
scripts.icons: npm run icons --workspace @dooz/web && tauri icon ../../assets/brand/tauri-icon.json --output src-tauri/icons/dooz && node ../web/scripts/finish-native-icons.mjs
